slides.title: 5 red flags your restaurant's paperwork is not handled

slides.myth: The liquor license renewal goes to the old manager's email
slides.fact: Renewal notices should land somewhere someone actually reads.

slides.myth: New holiday hires will "get their food handler cards next week"
slides.fact: Check the cards before the first shift, not after.

slides.myth: The health permit is on the wall, so we're fine
slides.fact: On the wall isn't the same as current. Know the date.

slides.title: Red flag #1: "It's handled."
slides.body: Ask who handles it. Save this before the holiday rush.
